newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Treasurer Peters welcomes inflation data.
newsitem.headline: NZ Treasurer Peters welcomes inflation data.

text.p: New Zealand Treasurer Winston Peters on Tuesday welcomed inflation data for the June quarter, which was in line with Reserve Bank and market expectations.
Earlier, the RBNZ calculated that core inflation in the quarter was 0.3 percent, for an annual rise of 1.49 percent.
"I am pleased that inflation has moved to the middle of the Reserve Bank's 0-3 percent target," Peters said in a statement.
"This latest figure is exactly in line with Reserve Bank projections of falling inflationary pressures."
The RBNZ and economists had expected 0.3 percent quarterly inflation.
Peters said it was pleasing to note the Bankers Trust New Zealand statement that the numbers represented excellent news on the inflation front.
